comments: This license has a Sun copyright notice. It is the same license as BSD-3-Clause-No-Nuclear-License, except it has a disclaimer for nuclear facility use, instead of the software "not licensed" for such use.

evidence.locator: text: opening grant paragraph ("Redistribution and use in source and binary forms, with or without modification, are permitted") together with the final sentence ("not designed or intended for use in the design, construction, operation or maintenance of any nuclear facility"); the added nuclear-facility purpose limitation makes this BSD-style variant nonstandard
text: opening grant and conditions 1-3; permission is non-reciprocal and no same-license, source-disclosure, corresponding-source, linking, or network-use condition is stated

text: conditions 1-2 (source redistributions must retain, and binary redistributions must reproduce in documentation and/or other materials, the copyright notice, list of conditions, and following disclaimer)

text: conditions 1-2 (notice-retention/reproduction duties attach to source or binary redistribution; modification alone has no separate condition, and the nuclear-facility sentence is a use restriction rather than a distribution trigger)

text: condition 3 (copyright-holder and contributor names may not be used to endorse or promote derived products without specific prior written permission); final nuclear-facility sentence is an additional field-of-use term; disclaimer paragraphs exclude warranties and limit liability
